header: Ten years of building the Lodestar archive
subheadline: Northstar Labs began as a two-person reading list in Vienna and now runs a peer-reviewed quarterly, a weekly briefing and an archive of 9,800 papers. Three moments did most of that work.

items.title: First issue, 180 pages
items.content: Four editors, one printer in the eleventh district, and 96 subscribers who paid a year in advance before a single page existed.

items.title: The Lisbon studio opens
items.content: Audio production and the Field Notes podcast moved south. Signal Weekly passed 12,000 subscribers in the same twelve months.

items.title: 1,240 papers in one year
items.content: The referee roster reached 210 researchers and the median first decision fell to 21 days, down from 74 days in 2023.
